A git checkout at a branch, tag or commit. Refresh notices when a branch moves on the remote. Removing it leaves the checkout.

```hcl
step "example" {
  git {
    dest = "..."
    repo = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dest` | string | Yes | Directory to check it out in. |
| `ref` | string | No | Branch, tag or full commit. Defaults to the remote's default branch. |
| `repo` | string | Yes | Repository URL. The host needs access to it. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_git.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `commit` | string | The commit checked out. |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the checkout is at the commit ref points to. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_git` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
